description: Na₃H₅(SeO₄)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six SeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 71°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with six SeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 71°. There are four shorter (2.44 Å) and two longer (2.58 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.21 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.62 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-52°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.76 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-56°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.74 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one H and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one H and one Se atom.
